 https://docs.luciq.ai/changelog#debug-faster-with-relevant-moments-and-multi-session-summary-in-session-replayWed, 04 Nov 2026 00:00:00 GMTSummary

See the moments that matter in a session without watching the whole recording, or get one summary across up to 10 filtered sessions to spot patterns faster.

#### What's new?

- Relevant Moments: Get a quick view of the relevant moments in a single session, right from the sessions list, so you can jump straight to what's important.

- Multi-Session Summary: Filter your sessions as usual, then click Generate summary to get one summary across up to 10 sessions at once.


#### Why this matters?

- You spend less time watching sessions one by one and more time fixing.

- You can spot patterns across sessions instead of judging an issue from a single recording, and get to the root cause faster.
